title: An Ext cocycle supplies a section cycle
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F$ an abelian sheaf, $I$ an injective resolution, and $q\geq0$. For a cocycle $a:\mathbf Z_X\to I^q$ with $a d^q=0$, there exists a cycle $z$ of $A=\Gamma(X,I^\bullet)$ [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction] such that the constant-sheaf adjunction applied to $a$ and evaluated at $1$ equals $iCycles(z)$.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, augmentation construction and omitted coefficient functoriality; Tag 01FD comparison diagram; explicit formal verification using the Mathlib APIs named in the proof

proof.text: The constant-sheaf adjunction takes a to an additive morphism from lifted integers into sections. Naturality takes a composed with the differential to the section differential composed with that morphism. Since the cocycle composite is zero and the additive adjunction preserves zero, this morphism factors through cycles. Evaluate the factor on 1 and use liftCycles_i.

theorem abelianCech_ext_section_cycle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (a : (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X q)
    (ha : a ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0) :
    ∃ z : (abelianCechSections I).cycles q,
      ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ _ a) (ULift.up 1) =
          (abelianCechSections I).iCycles q z
